result.topic_en: Riemann defines classes of algebraic equations F(s,z)=0 (and systems of equally branched algebraic functions) that can be transformed into each other by rational substitutions, and counts branch values and free constants (2(m_1+p-1) branch values, 2m_1-p+1 arbitrary constants).
